verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Tuwaayo gy'oli-omwana-ono
Ayingire mu kisibo
Anywezebwe mu kwagala.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Omwana wo omwagalwa
Teyagoba baaba bato;
Ne kaakano tumuwaayo
Omunyweze mu mikono gyo.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Mu biro eby'okukemebwa
Muwenga obuwanguzi,
Ayolese-ekitiibwa kyo;
Bonna bakutendereze.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Era ne ku nkomerero
Bw'olijja mu kitiibwa kyo,
Asanyuke okuweebwa
Engule gye wasuubiza
